# Package `embed`

```go
package embed
```

Package embed provides access to files embedded by //go:embed directives.

## Types

### type FS

```go
type FS struct { ... }
```

FS is a read-only collection of files initialized by the compiler. Its zero value is an empty file system.

#### func FS.Open

```go
func (filesystem FS) Open(name string) (fs.File, error)
```

Open opens the named file for reading and returns it as an [fs.File](io/fs.md#type-file).

The returned file implements [io.Seeker](io.md#type-seeker) and [io.ReaderAt](io.md#type-readerat) when the file is not a directory.

#### func FS.ReadDir

```go
func (filesystem FS) ReadDir(name string) ([]fs.DirEntry, error)
```

ReadDir reads and returns the entire named directory.

#### func FS.ReadFile

```go
func (filesystem FS) ReadFile(name string) ([]byte, error)
```

ReadFile reads and returns the content of the named file.
